# The Pilates Programme, Altrincham

> Pilates and Barre teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester. Small cohorts, in-person coaching, the full spectrum from contrology and classical to contemporary.

Training centre: 23 Central Way, Altrincham, WA14 1RF, UK. Email: info@thepilatesprogramme.co.uk.
Accreditation: Mat and Reformer teacher training internationally accredited by ITTAP via the Pilates Method Alliance (PMA); Barre teacher training accredited by the Barre Fitness Alliance (the only one in the UK); Prenatal and Postpartum CPD endorsed by CIMSPA. Courses are certifications.
Not to be confused with the Irish on-demand app of a similar name. This is the Altrincham, Greater Manchester teacher training provider.

## Teacher training (certify)
- [Mat Pilates Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/become-a-pilates-instructor/mat-pilates-teacher-training): £2,200. A Mat Pilates teacher training covering beginner to advanced repertoire across the full spectrum of Pilates, from contrology and classical through to contemporary. Four in-person days, usually at our Altrincham training centre, plus our online HUMAN MOVEMENT course, your practice hours and the exams, all included for £2,200 or four interest-free payments. No prior certification needed.
- [Reformer Pilates Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/become-a-pilates-instructor/reformer-pilates-teacher-training): £2,200. A Reformer Pilates teacher training covering the beginner and intermediate repertoire, classical and contemporary. Five in-person days on full apparatus, usually at our Altrincham training centre, plus our online HUMAN MOVEMENT course, your practice hours and the exams, all included for £2,200 or four interest-free payments. No prior certification needed.
- [Barre Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/become-a-pilates-instructor/barre-teacher-training): £2,200. The only Barre teacher training certification in the UK accredited by the Barre Fitness Alliance, built from years of teaching thousands of classes. Five in-person days, usually at our Altrincham training centre, plus our HUMAN MOVEMENT anatomy course, your practice hours and the exams, all included for £2,200 or four interest-free payments. No prior certification needed.

## Continuing education (certified teachers)
- [Advanced Reformer Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/advanced-reformer): Price on request (prerequisite: An existing Reformer teaching certification). An in-person Advanced Reformer course in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, for teachers who already hold a Reformer certification. It covers the advanced Classical order and Contemporary progressions, spotting and programming. The manual, exam, online platform access with a 6-week free trial and an interest-free payment plan are all included. Returning students receive 10% off.
- [Chair Pilates Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/chair): £1,200 (prerequisite: An existing Mat or Reformer teaching certification). An in-person Wunda Chair teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, for teachers with an existing Mat or Reformer certification. It covers Classical repertoire and Contemporary variations with assessment included, for £1,200. Book Cadillac, Chair and Barrels together for £2,700 and Barrels is free.
- [Cadillac Pilates Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cadillac): £1,500 (prerequisite: An existing Mat or Reformer teaching certification). An in-person Cadillac teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, for teachers with an existing Mat or Reformer certification. It covers Classical repertoire, springs, bars and straps, and Contemporary variations, with assessment included, for £1,500. Book Cadillac, Chair and Barrels together for £2,700 and Barrels is free.
- [Barrels Pilates Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/barrels): £800 (prerequisite: An existing Mat or Reformer teaching certification). An in-person Barrels teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, covering the Ladder Barrel, Spine Corrector and Arc for teachers with an existing Mat or Reformer certification. Assessment included, for £800. Barrels is free when you book Cadillac, Chair and Barrels together for £2,700.
- [Cadillac, Chair and Barrels Bundle](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/apparatus-bundle): £2,700 (prerequisite: An existing Mat or Reformer teaching certification). The apparatus bundle combines the Cadillac, Chair and Barrels teacher trainings at The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for £2,700, with Barrels included free. It is for teachers with an existing Mat or Reformer certification who want to teach on full apparatus. Each course includes a manual, video library and assessment.
- [Prenatal and Postpartum Pilates CPD](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cpd/prenatal-postpartum): £250 (prerequisite: A Pilates or Barre teaching certification from any provider). A one-day in-person CPD at The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for certified Pilates and Barre teachers from any provider. It covers pregnancy anatomy, trimester modifications, postpartum return to movement and when to refer, for £250 or two interest-free instalments. Returning students receive 10% off.
- [Strength and Endurance Pilates CPD](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cpd/strength-endurance): £250 (prerequisite: A Pilates or Barre teaching certification from any provider). A one-day in-person CPD at The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for certified Pilates and Barre teachers from any provider. It covers progressive overload, programming for strength and endurance, load and tempo choices and tracking progress, for £250 or two interest-free instalments. Returning students receive 10% off.
- [Jumpboard Pilates CPD (online)](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cpd/jumpboard-online): £250 (prerequisite: A Reformer teaching certification from any provider). An online, on-demand Jumpboard CPD from The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for Reformer teachers from any provider. It covers set-up and safety, foot positions and landing mechanics, programming cardio blocks and contraindications, for £250 or two interest-free instalments, with a certificate on completion.
- [Pain Science for Pilates Teachers CPD](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cpd/pain-science): £250 (prerequisite: A Pilates or Barre teaching certification from any provider). A one-day in-person CPD at The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for certified Pilates and Barre teachers from any provider. It covers current models of pain, language that helps, graded exposure in a Pilates setting and scope of practice, for £250 or two interest-free instalments. Returning students receive 10% off.
